audiences.jobToBeDone: Understand Tolani governance, TUT utility and eligible participation without confusing token possession, voting, delegation or evidence receipts with legal DAO membership, investment rights or automatic token issuance.

offers.description: Governance, TUT utility, evidence-authority, treasury-policy and eligible-participation information.

valueProposition: Provide the canonical governance, TUT utility and evidence-authority layer for the Tolani ecosystem while separating source evidence, legal membership and treasury execution.
differentiators: Canonical Tolani Ecosystem DAO governance authority
Human treasury authorization before economic execution
prohibitedClaims: Guaranteed token value, price appreciation, return or liquidity
Dividend, revenue-share, interest, principal, equity or subsidiary-ownership claims
TUT possession, voting power, delegation or utility rewards automatically create legal DAO membership
A source-system evidence receipt automatically creates reward eligibility or authorizes TUT issuance
Any Tolani operating entity may accept TUT before that utility is activated in the authorized utility registry
Commercial claims that belong to operating subsidiaries

operationalHandoff.system: TUT Utility & Evidence Authority Plane v1. Production minting, token transfer execution, automatic reward distribution and live entity TUT acceptance remain disabled until separately authorized.

legalAndCompliance.rule: Utility and governance messaging must not be reframed as investment solicitation. TUT possession, voting, delegation, utility rewards or evidence receipts do not by themselves establish legal DAO membership or token issuance authority.
